latest_release.name: Momentum Update (v3.4.0)
latest_release.body:
Arnis worlds now come alive. Buildings got a fresh look and forests got 610 new tree models. Cars drive the streets and trams, metros and trains run the mapped tracks on real timetables, on Java and Bedrock. A new Gameplay section for Java adds working traffic lights, a Zombie Outbreak and a Disasters mode. Mobs can now spawn on their own too. Any area can also be built in Winter or Post-Apocalyptic style, or as a Blueprint with buildings as outlines to build on. Distant Horizons LODs can be pre-generated, and large areas generate up to twice as fast. ## Assets * Windows: arnis-windows.exe * Linux: arnis-linux * MacOS: arnis-mac-universal **Scroll down to find the download in _Assets._**
Click to expand ## What's Changed * Add optional gameplay extras: traffic lights, moving cars, pause menu and more by @louis-e in https://github.com/louis-e/arnis/pull/1392 * Add Romanian language by @Sycrophic789 in https://github.com/louis-e/arnis/pull/1386 * Limit tile concurrency based on available RAM by @Sycrophic789 in https://github.com/louis-e/arnis/pull/1387 * Make generated buildings look more realistic by @louis-e in https://github.com/louis-e/arnis/pull/1395 * 3D models improvements by @louis-e in https://github.com/louis-e/arnis/pull/1399 * Tree size realism and 610 community tree models by @louis-e in https://github.com/louis-e/arnis/pull/1401 * Rail bridge decks and joined side-by-side tracks by @louis-e in https://github.com/louis-e/arnis/pull/1402 * Keep barriers off roads, add gates and fix barrier heights by @louis-e in https://github.com/louis-e/arnis/pull/1404 * Piers, shelters, masts, chimneys, wells, cranes, summit crosses and hedge fix by @louis-e in https://github.com/louis-e/arnis/pull/1405 * Speed up large-area generation and cut its peak RAM by @louis-e in https://github.com/louis-e/arnis/pull/1406 * Bump rustls from 0.23.40 to 0.23.43 in the cargo group across 1 directory by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/louis-e/arnis/pull/1407 * Sign the Windows release with SignPath by @louis-e in https://github.com/louis-e/arnis/pull/1408 * State the code signing roles in one sentence by @louis-e in https://github.com/louis-e/arnis/pull/1410 * Keep louis-e on one line in the code signing policy by @louis-e in https://github.com/louis-e/arnis/pull/1411 * Natural terrain-only with water, blueprint mode, winter and post-apocalyptic settings by @louis-e in https://github.com/louis-e/arnis/pull/1414 * Fix 3.3.0 crash reports and size limits: One World overflow and climate, Bedrock staging, telemetry paths, archive area and disk checks by @louis-e in https://github.com/louis-e/arnis/pull/1415 * Follow-ups from the second review of #1415 by @louis-e in https://github.com/louis-e/arnis/pull/1416 * Fix floating lights and stray leaves, build construction sites, stop cars spinning by @louis-e in https://github.com/louis-e/arnis/pull/1418 * Run trains on the tracks, join rails on curves and slopes, stop cars circling a waypoint by @louis-e in https://github.com/louis-e/arnis/pull/1419 * Make building facades more realistic: glass towers, pre-war masonry and tag fidelity by @louis-e in https://github.com/louis-e/arnis/pull/1423 * Add discord popup by @louis-e in https://github.com/louis-e/arnis/pull/1424 * Build ski lifts, petrol stations and funfair rides by @louis-e in https://github.com/louis-e/arnis/pull/1421 * Remove water from fields by @louis-e in https://github.com/louis-e/arnis/pull/1425 * Cut the inner rings out of landuse, natural and park relations by @louis-e in https://github.com/louis-e/arnis/pull/1426 * Same sort in CLI and GUI,
